entities.name: PMID:25070787
observations: Comparative pediatric water-load study of obese (n=60) and normal-weight (n=27) participants aged 9–17; obese participants consumed 478 ± 222 mL before fullness versus 385 ± 115 mL (P<0.05).

entities.name: Greater water load to fullness
observations: In a water-load task, obese youth consumed about 20% more water before reporting fullness than normal-weight youth (478 ± 222 vs 385 ± 115 mL; P<0.05); this is not a direct measurement of gastric capacity or distension.
